Theme 037 · Light, optics & texture

X-Ray / Thermal Scanner

On the surface every dashboard card looks healthy. A bright scanner band passes over them and, inside it, the product turns to X-ray: the hidden skeleton of the flow glows in bone-white lines, and one bone is fractured. A thermal pass then shows the heat spreading around the break until a human cools it down.

COMPONENT KIT

  • Surface cards — ordinary healthy-looking UI with green "✓ OK" chips; the lie on the surface.
  • Scanner band — bright-edged vertical band with a soft bleed; everything inside it is X-ray.
  • Skeleton layer — the product's hidden flow (Visit → Cart → Checkout → Paid) drawn as glowing bones and joints.
  • Fracture — a coral zigzag break between two bones; the anomaly, precisely located.
  • Thermal LUT — navy → teal → amber → coral → white legend; heat means risk.
  • Hot-spot readout — "RISK 0.87 · DEPLOY #2231" callout over the heat bloom.

MOTION · MUSIC

  • Band mask — clip-path inset() window travelling at constant speed, 1 frame-width per bar (2 s at 120 BPM); only inside the band is X-ray.
  • Palette switch — X-ray → thermal via CSS filter / SVG feComponentTransfer cross-fade over 400 ms, exactly on a downbeat.
  • Heat bloom — hot spot scales 0.9 → 1.1 with sine.inOut on a 1.2 s loop; cools right→left for the CTA.

WHY / RISK · ADAPT IT

It shows the product's core truth in one image: the surface looks fine while something underneath is broken, and only a scan can see it. Risk: medical imagery can feel clinical or alarming; keep fractures small and always resolve them with a human decision.

Adapt to your product: Put your own dashboard on the surface and draw your real pipeline or architecture as the skeleton; the fracture sits wherever your product finds problems.
